summary: The purpose of this subchapter is to provide guidance regarding the use of information request letters (IRLs) and information notices (INs).
quote: The purpose of this subchapter is to provide guidance regarding the use of information request letters (IRLs) and information notices (INs).

summary: IRLs are personalized, standardized letters with a date and signature block that request from the applicant additional information, documentation, or action needed to process the passport application.

scope_quotes: You must fully adjudicate the application prior to suspending to ensure that you are addressing all issues.

summary: The IRLs have been carefully crafted to communicate clearly and accurately statutory, regulatory, and other requirements of the Department.

summary: Passport agencies/centers must not make unilateral changes or alterations to the IRLs without the approval of the Office of Adjudication (CA/PPT/S/A) except on a case-by-case basis with the approval of passport agency/center management in extenuating circumstances (for example, when you request that the applicant submit a birth certificate instead of a notification of birth registration, and the applicant insists that the notification of birth registration is the birth certificate).

summary: Posts must use the cleared language in the IRLs, but are authorized to modify the language to suit local logistical requirements and other local concerns such as available documentation.
quote: (2) Posts must use the cleared language in the IRLs, but are authorized to modify the language to suit local logistical requirements and other local concerns such as available documentation.
NOTE : IRLs are not adjudicative guidance.

summary: The passport application must be adjudicated in accordance with the 8 FAM and then the appropriate IRL selected to address any deficiencies with the passport or Consular Report of Birth Abroad (CRBA).
